name: Pothole Complaint Bot (Telegram + AI + Google Sheets)

parameters.text:
=Welcome to the Pothole Complaint Bot.

To file a complaint, send ONE text message describing:
1. The problem (size, danger, traffic impact)
2. The exact location (street, landmark, area, city)

Photo is optional. If you add one, write the description as the photo caption.

Example: Big pothole near Gandhi Maidan gate 3, Patna. Two bikes slipped yesterday.

To check progress, send: /status PTH-YYYYMMDD-NNNN

=We could not file this complaint yet.

What we need:
{{ $json.reasons.map(r => '- ' + r).join('\n') }}

Please send one message with the problem and the exact location. A photo is optional. Send /help for an example.
